propositions: rebar verify-commit-ticket fails 'ticket store not found' in a fresh linked worktree because it is a pure intercept dispatched before the arms that call ensure_initialized and does not self-manage mount.
The store-mount step is replicated per dispatch-arm and skipped by pure intercepts, making 'command forgot to mount the store' structurally possible.
The mount half (ensure_initialized init_only via _create_tracker) should run at one central CLI choke point before both pure intercepts and set-based dispatch for every store-touching command.
Commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must not be force-mounted and must keep working without a store.
The REBAR_TRACKER_DIR override must short-circuit the central gate so tests and embedding are unaffected.
Library import and MCP intentionally do not auto-mount and remain unchanged; the reconverge half stays in the leaves via the _reads facade.
